page.layout: One text column, full width, with the page number and division heading above it. No margin notes. Below the last line: a gathering signature at the left and a catchword at the right.

main_text.l: PAx Domini sit super Mosem filium
precibus, jejuniis & abstinentia excelsum: utinam Dominus
vestris, & odio habeat eos, qui vos ode-
runt, & exaltetur Deus noster super id, quod exaltatur
super nos & super vos propter laborem justorum patrum no-
Isaaci & Jacobi, super quos sit pax.
tionis Israelis, quæ est in Ægypto, ado-
rans in monte Garizim domo Domini
ad Dominum nostrum famæ optimæ, & columen Congregationis| & Principem Principum custodientium legem, qui diligit

page.notes: The mark "|" after "Congregationis" is doubtful and may be a printer's mark or a reference sign. The catchword "ligit" is the first word of the next page. The signature "G 5" is read from a small mark at the foot. The text ends mid-word with the printed hyphen in "di-", which is the start of "diligit" on the next line.
